maria: Quick heads-up, prepping a short internal release note for a staging rollout at 17:30 UTC. Need copycheck and rollback criteria confirmation. @sam @sylvia

maria: Draft RN:
```
Staging deploy (db-7243): inference kernel & quant profile update. Expect ~15% median latency improvement on long-context requests and modest embedding cost reduction. No API changes.
Canary: 10% for a 10m health window -> 100% if healthy.
Auto-rollback: revert to model-v1.9-quant if failure rate >3% sustained for 5m or error spike.
```

sam: Ack. Do we want a 50% intermediate step? 10->100 is fast.

maria: Prefer 10->100 after 10m to get quick signal.

deploy-bot: @maria scheduled job db-7243 for 2024-08-21T17:30:00Z. Will post updates.

sylvia: Small copy edits: replace "inference kernel" -> "inference kernels" and note this is internal-only. Add verification step.

evan: Internal announce draft (short):
```
Internal: staging rollout 17:30 UTC (db-7243)
- What: kernels + quant profile update; ~15% p50 improvement on long-context; lower embedding token cost.
- Verify: check rollout dashboard p50/p95 and run `curl -sS https://staging-api.internal/health`.
- Rollback: auto-fallback to model-v1.9-quant on >3% failures sustained 5m; manual rollback by oncall.
Ping @oncall-lisa for issues.
```

oncall-lisa: I'll be on standby 17:15-18:00 UTC. Manual rollback threshold: sustained 5xx >1% for 5m. Assigning myself to the run.

maria: Thanks all. Posting final RN to internal console and pinning in #eng-releases. :white_check_mark:

sam: Watching metrics during canary.

sylvia: LGTM from comms; no external blast.

deploy-bot: db-7243 update: queued -> started at 2024-08-21T17:30:12Z.

maria: Closing thread unless rollback or issues occur.
